description: RAIN watches the schedule, the reminder queue, and the eligibility responses overnight and surfaces the scheduling signals before you ask — high no-show-risk visits, open telehealth slots going unused, and coverage checks coming back inactive — so the front desk starts the day ahead of the phones.

Scores every booked visit's no-show risk from its pattern profile — no-show and late-cancel history, reply time per channel, preferred language, travel time, and visit type — the transparent BR-01/BR-02 rules the MVP runs before a prediction model replaces them in phase 2.

Matches high-risk in-person bookings against live telehealth slot inventory, travel time, and device access in one conversation — the same cross-system reasoning that used to take a phone call, an EHR tab, and a paper slot sheet.

Builds the per-patient reminder plans — channel, language, timing, touch count — directly from the conversation, enforces the consent, quiet-hours, PHI, and frequency rules on every message, and escalates non-responders to ranked CHW call tasks at the cut-off.
